reports.title: One Bradenton Buy Box, Two Very Different Waits for a Contract
reports.excerpt: Two nearby Bradenton ZIP codes with similar pricing showed dramatically different speeds to pending — one taking ~119 days, the other ~60. The wait, not the price, is what separates these markets right now.

reports.title: In Saint Petersburg, Sellers Are Getting Less Money, But Giving Up Less Ground
reports.excerpt: Median sale prices fell ~11% year-over-year to $398K, yet the sale-to-list ratio improved to 97.1% — buyers are closing the gap to asking price, not scoring discounts.

reports.title: In Myakka City, Sellers Are Winning on Price. They're Losing Ground at the Table.
reports.excerpt: Median sale prices climbed ~10% year-over-year to $785K, but the sale-to-list ratio dropped from 96.6% to 92%. Sellers get paid well — but they're conceding more than the price chart shows.
